about: Unseen regression sentences (invented, none from any case), one for every pronunciation failure found so far, with the failure it guards against. The expected IRAB was written from the project's REFERENCE_IRAB convention before the code was run. Not reviewed by a linguist.

cases.name: consonant h with ezafe takes a kasra
cases.failure: hamza written on a final h said as a consonant (دادگاهٔ)

cases.name: final i with ezafe: kasra on its own yeh
cases.failure: a second yeh added after a final i

cases.name: indefinite after a silent heh, written e+i
cases.failure: the scheme wrote e+i as the diphthong ey

cases.name: i and y in one yeh before a short vowel
i and a doubled y in one yeh
cases.failure: i+yy written by one yeh with a shadda

cases.name: an ayn the colloquial reading leaves out
the h of a colloquial plural
cases.failure: h of the plural ها left out in speech
cases.note: expectation corrected after the first run: b is followed by ā (the plural's h is not said), so it carries no mark

cases.name: the alef that starts a compound's second part
alef madda inside a word
cases.note: expectation corrected after the first run: r is followed by ā, so it carries no mark

cases.name: g and h, not gh
cases.failure: the scheme's gh read as one sound where the letters are گ+ه

cases.name: z and h, not zh
cases.failure: the scheme's zh read as ژ

cases.name: initial ayn before a long vowel
cases.failure: ayn starting a word with a long vowel

cases.name: the same consonant twice across a half-space
one written word read as several, the text's own mark kept
cases.failure: a written word read as several; an alignment that moved the text's own kasra
cases.note: the first run found an alignment against the text's kasra (the validator rejected it); the aligner now keeps the text's marks. The hand-written expectation then missed the sukun on the y after آ: corrected.

cases.name: a reading the letters cannot spell stays unwritten
cases.failure: a colloquial reading the letters cannot show

cases.name: oo is the scheme's u
cases.failure: Finglish oo / ee: oo is u, ee is not a reading of the scheme
